cat > build.py << 'EOF'
from rdkit import Chem
from rdkit.Chem import AllChem
import numpy as np

smi = ("[NH](CCn1nc(C)c(/N=N/c2ccccc2)c(C)1)(CCn3nc(C)c(/N=N/c4ccccc4)c(C)3)"
       ".[Ni].Cl.Cl")
mol = Chem.MolFromSmiles(smi)
print("parsed:", mol is not None, mol.GetNumAtoms())

rw = Chem.RWMol(mol)
# find indices
ni_idx = [a.GetIdx() for a in rw.GetAtoms() if a.GetSymbol()=="Ni"][0]
cl_idx = [a.GetIdx() for a in rw.GetAtoms() if a.GetSymbol()=="Cl"]
# amine N: N with 3 heavy neighbors (H implicit)
amine_idx = None
n2_idx = []
for a in rw.GetAtoms():
    if a.GetSymbol()=="N":
        nbrs = [n.GetIdx() for n in a.GetNeighbors()]
        if len(nbrs)==3 and all(rw.GetAtomWithIdx(i).GetSymbol()=="C" for i in nbrs):
            amine_idx = a.GetIdx()
        # ring N with exactly 2 neighbors, one N one C, in ring, not bonded to CH2
        if len(nbrs)==2 and a.GetIsAromatic():
            syms = sorted(rw.GetAtomWithIdx(i).GetSymbol() for i in nbrs)
            if syms==["C","N"]:
                # N2 type (unsubstituted, double-bonded in kekule)
                n2_idx.append(a.GetIdx())
print("Ni",ni_idx,"Cl",cl_idx,"amine",amine_idx,"N2",n2_idx)

rw.GetAtomWithIdx(ni_idx).SetNoImplicit(True)
b1 = rw.AddBond(ni_idx, cl_idx[0], Chem.BondType.SINGLE)
b2 = rw.AddBond(ni_idx, cl_idx[1], Chem.BondType.SINGLE)
b3 = rw.AddBond(amine_idx, ni_idx, Chem.BondType.SINGLE)
for n in n2_idx:
    rw.AddBond(n, ni_idx, Chem.BondType.DATIVE)

m = rw.GetMol()
Chem.SanitizeMol(m, Chem.SanitizeFlags.SANITIZE_ALL ^ Chem.SanitizeFlags.SANITIZE_PROPERTIES)
print("sanitized ok")
m = Chem.AddHs(m)
print("atoms with H:", m.GetNumAtoms())
ok = AllChem.EmbedMolecule(m, randomSeed=0xf00d, useRandomCoords=True)
print("embed:", ok)
AllChem.UFFOptimizeMolecule(m, maxIters=5000)
Chem.MolToMolFile(m, "complex_init.mol")
# write xyz
conf = m.GetConformer()
els = [a.GetSymbol() for a in m.GetAtoms()]
with open("complex_init.xyz","w") as f:
    f.write(f"{m.GetNumAtoms()}\ninit Ni complex\n")
    for i,a in enumerate(m.GetAtoms()):
        p = conf.GetAtomPosition(i)
        f.write(f"{a.GetSymbol()} {p.x:.6f} {p.y:.6f} {p.z:.6f}\n")
print("written")
EOF

worst=[]
for i,j in itertools.combinations(range(n),2):
    if (i,j) in bonded: continue
    d=np.linalg.norm(xyz[i]-xyz[j])
    lim=1.6 if ("H" in (ats[i],ats[j])) else 2.0
    if d<lim: worst.append((i,ats[i],j,ats[j],round(float(d),2)))
print("clashes:", worst[:10])
from collections import Counter
print(Counter(ats))
